Kiran runs the entire marketing engine at Studyfetch AI, a bootstrapped app that grew to 7 million users and 2 billion views without any venture funding before raising an 11.5 million dollar Series A with the College Board backing the round. In this episode he pulls back the curtain on the full creator program that made it happen, and it is not what most people expect.

Instead of hiring hundreds of cheap UGC creators to mass post content, Studyfetch pays five figures a month to influencers with 750K followers to start brand new accounts from zero. Those zero follower accounts are consistently outperforming everything else in their program because the influencer's existing audience follows them over, and the content feels authentic instead of like an obvious ad. Kiran walks through exactly how they find and vet creators, how they structure retainer deals and bonus systems, why TikTok converts at a completely different rate than Instagram Reels, and how the team manages hundreds of creators at once without losing quality control.

We also get into the 75 million view lecture hall video that drove hundreds of thousands of signups, why virality at all costs is the wrong strategy, and what Kiran would look for if he had to build the marketing team from scratch today.
